# messq_verify

See `messq help exit-codes` for the exit-code contract.

## messq verify

check a data directory's invariants

### Synopsis

Run the invariant checker over a messq data directory and report each check
as ok, violated or skipped.

verify works on a stopped directory, a live one, or a backup copy,
and answers "is my broker's state sound?" in seconds. Its exit codes
(0 clean, 1 violations found, 2 usage, 3 directory missing, 7 not
permitted) are part of the crash-harness contract.

```
messq verify [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  messq verify --data-dir /var/lib/messq --deep
```
